passenger_response.subject: Your cancelled flight AK588
passenger_response.body:
Dear Oliver Ashworth,

Flight AK588 on 2026-08-08 was cancelled. Our record shows the cause was that the captain was unfit to fly and no standby captain was available at LHR. The Aerlink LIS service was suspended for the rest of that date, with the next own-metal service on 2026-08-10.

We have not booked you onto anything. Nothing on our own flights matched what you asked for on that date, so a colleague has to decide what to offer you next.

We cannot work out compensation yet. It depends on how late you actually arrive at your final destination, and that is not known until your new flight has run. It will be assessed then. Do not read this as a decision either way.

As the flight was cancelled, care is owed immediately. This includes meals and refreshments up to £30 per passenger per six hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to £180 per room per night for a maximum of three nights, subject to station allocation, and transport up to £45 per journey.

Kind regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
